newsitem.title: UK: Moody's "comfortable" with Russia's rating - Levey.
newsitem.headline: Moody's "comfortable" with Russia's rating - Levey.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service managing director David Levey said the rating agency was comfortable with its current Ba2 sovereign debt rating of Russia.
"We are quite comfortable with Ba2 on Russia," Levey told a conference on Central and Eastern European Capital Markets in London on Friday.
He said the range of ratings for the 12-country region spanned the highest A3 for Slovenia and the lowest B3 for Bulgaria.
"Moving up of ratings will be relatively sticky," he said.
Meanwhile Standard and Poor's said in March it had no immediate plan to lift Russia's sovereign credit rating.
S&P assigned a BB- rating on Russia's long-term foreign currency debt in October 1996, with a stable outlook.
